## Acceptance Criteria

This research task is complete when:

- [ ] The main research questions are answered
- [ ] Sources, datasets, or references are linked
- [ ] Assumptions and limitations are clearly stated
- [ ] Findings are summarized in the issue, a document, notebook, or PR
- [ ] Any follow-up tasks are listed as new issues, if needed
